author: Enclosure and Structural Designer
purpose: search: 400W solar panel dimensions size weight
output_full:
s0larpanel.com — SolarPeak Pro 400 — https://www.s0larpanel.com/product-detail.html
(found by the search; not opened or cited)
Enclosure and Structural Designer said about it: The module datasheet in PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Performance (E64) lists dimensions 1722 by 1134 by 30 mm and weight 20.5 kg, matched by dimensions 1762 by 1134 by 30 mm and weight 21.5 kg in SolarPeak Pro 400 (E65), giving six-module footprint 11.7 square metres in the panel footprint calc (E69), about a parking space, against a 2.4 m by 1.8 m roof of 4.32 square metres, so the split shade with 2 Photovoltaic (PV, solar-electric panel) modules on the roof gantry plus 4 modules on a separate ground frame on own footings in that same split layout sketch (E70) carries no panel loads into sandwich panels and keeps the vent gap that holds the 203 watt conduction in Professional Manufacturer Factory Keep Warm Insulated PU Sandwich Panel (E32).
